name: @mark1russell7/ts-base
description: TypeScript project configuration with hyper-strict tsconfig composition
author: Mark Russell <marktheprogrammer17@gmail.com>

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter @ts-base/site run typecheck

cue-preset.reason: ts-base publishes its own set of tsconfig presets (./tsconfig/*.json), apart from @mark1russell7/cue. The site package extends the preset frontend.json of this repository, so each build of the site tests a preset that the repository publishes. A cue preset here would test the wrong presets. The check of the strict options still runs against the preset that it extends.
